title: Chicken and mushroom pie
summary: Cubed chicken and mushrooms in a creamy béchamel, under a golden puff pastry lid.
serves: one pie, in a pie dish
intro: My gran Prema's pie, the one I used to wait to buy at the garage in SA.

items.item: milk (or fresh cream or heavy cream)
Parmesan cheese (be careful, it can make the dish more salty)

steps.title: Season and sizzle the chicken and mushrooms
tasks: Rinse the chicken fillets, cut them into cubes and pop them in a bowl.
Season with salt, black pepper, oregano, sweet basil, garlic powder and ginger powder. Rub the spices into the meat properly. Don't be shy.

Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a pot or pan over medium heat. Add the seasoned chicken, stir, cover with a lid and cook for 10 minutes. Do not drain the liquid that collects. That's flavour, boet.
Stir in the sliced mushrooms, cover, and cook for another 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and set it aside.
steps.note: Ja, the whole house is going to smell lekker. Prepare to be hungry.
steps.caption: Chicken and mushrooms, getting to know each other.

steps.title: Whisk up the béchamel
tasks: In a separate pot, melt the butter over medium heat.
Whisk in the flour non-stop so it doesn't burn. No wandering off.
Slowly pour in the milk (or cream), stirring until it thickens into a creamy sauce.
Stir in the nutmeg, salt to taste and the Parmesan, then take it off the heat.
steps.note: Keep whisking. Lumps are not part of the plan.
steps.caption: Silky white sauce. Zero lumps allowed.
steps.alt: A pot of smooth white béchamel sauce, dusted with fresh nutmeg.

steps.title: Bring the filling together
tasks: Pour the white sauce into the pot with the chicken and mushrooms and mix until everything is properly coated.
Spoon the filling into your pie dish/pie mold. Ag, it already smells lekker.
steps.note: Taste it. Okay, now stop tasting it.
steps.caption: Creamy, chunky and ready to go.
steps.alt: Chicken pieces and sliced mushrooms folded through a creamy white sauce in a pan.

steps.title: Roof it with pastry
tasks: Lightly flour your work surface and unroll the puff pastry. Roll it out if you need to, so it covers the top of your dish.
Lay the pastry over the pie dish, trim the excess, and crimp or tuck the edges with your fingers (this is always a little tricky for me).
Brush the whole top with beaten egg.
Cut shapes from the leftover scraps (I prefer little hearts), set them on top, give everything another light coat of egg wash and sprinkle with sesame.
steps.note: Hearts or no hearts, it's your pie. But hearts.
steps.caption: Little hearts on top, because why not.
steps.alt: An unbaked puff pastry pie in a baking dish, glossy with egg wash, with little pastry hearts and sesame seeds on top.

steps.title: Bake until golden
tasks: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the pastry is puffed up and golden brown.
Serve hot. Give it a few minutes first, ja? Your tongue will thank you.
steps.note: Now-now it'll be gone, so take the photo first.
steps.caption: Golden. Puffed. Done.
steps.alt: A golden, puffed chicken and mushroom pie with little pastry hearts on top.

dishAlt: A golden, puffed chicken and mushroom pie with little pastry hearts on top.
